images.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: single rehabilitation exercise step photograph, action 098 T-LOW-023, preparation phase.
Use all three input photos only as identity and visual-style references. Same adult East Asian woman with black ponytail, plain white short-sleeve fitted T-shirt, dark charcoal trousers, and plain white athletic sneakers. Soft photorealistic studio image with gray-blue wall and matte nonslip floor. One woman only.
Make one full-body photograph, landscape framing, head to both whole shoes visible with floor margin. Camera at her right-front oblique side, about 30 degrees from side view, woman facing image right, head neutral. Fixed waist-high stainless handrail bolted securely to wall along her LEFT side, left hand resting gripping it naturally; right hand empty relaxed by right thigh. A stable LOW bench (about 25 cm high) with soft dark gray padded top stands behind her right foot, firmly against wall, all legs visibly supported by floor.
Pose for this image only: she stands upright and balanced with BOTH FEET FLAT ON FLOOR, left foot in front and right foot a modest step behind. Right rear foot is still on FLOOR immediately in front of the bench, not on the bench, ready for subsequent lifting. Left foot complete sole on floor. Comfortable split stance, knees softly straight, pelvis and chest neutral. Bench and rear-foot pathway unobstructed, equipment and contacts completely clear.
Constraints: standalone one pose photo, no collage, no panels, no text, no numbering, no symbols, no arrows, no watermark, no weights or kettlebells, no extra people. Anatomy realistic. Match reference face, hair, clothes and gray-blue background.
